name: lvx_notification_insert_message

ownership.return_value: void; r0 is residue from freeing the temporary normalized message, not delivery status

provenance.source: Exact .139 string xref to lvx_notification_insert_message at 0x2cb068ab, verified against notification clone/insertion/reminder code and stock activity/weather callers.

notes: Replaces false ensemble match 0xc370ad0 (NSH /proc/memdump command). Requires the .139 96-byte message with start_reminder at +88, not the 10 Pro 88-byte layout. Native Manager uses this only from the existing miwear/UI-owner install paths after identity validation. General SDK exposure remains pending a hardware probe; no reliable delivery result is returned. Crash3 consumer audit: reminders require a non-null 16-byte user context at message+92 even when is_focus (+90) is zero; context is borrowed, not deep-copied. See EVID-NOTIFICATION-4139-002.
